request: Reduce host overhead on the game thread (points 1-4 of the performance report); indexed vertices deferred
evidence: Unattended stack profile: 33.7% of game-thread samples ended in host DLLs. Attributed to their EXE callers: time base reads ~11-13% (all from OSGetTime 0x804E824C called by CGraphics BeginScene 0x803E9F78, i.e. the wait for the previous frame's GPU breakpoint), GX lock wait ~6% (host_lock_wait_ms 1.0-3.0 s per 10 s), F9 host sampler ~4%, log stream formatting ~2.3%, disc read path ~1%.

applied.1_performance_panel_default_off: F9 panel starts hidden; the choice is saved ([prime] show_performance_panel). While visible it samples host CPU on the game thread and enables producer profiling.
applied.2_io_logging: Disc reads no longer re-read every byte for an FNV check nor log 3 lines each; IOS di/kd/ioctl lines likewise. The first 32 per site are still logged; WII_COMPILED_TRACE_PRIME_IO=1 restores all (runtime_log.h RtLogRepeated). std::cerr now writes whole lines per thread (one pipe write per line, lines no longer interleave between threads).
applied.texture_decode_pool_fix: DecodePool::run: helpers that start after the caller returned no longer touch its stack (shared-owned state). This was the cause of the Main Menu crash (and stack corruption seen as a fault in webgpu_dawn.dll).
applied.crash_log_module: Structured exceptions now log the faulting module and offset.

not_applied.3_time_base: Discarded after measuring: the reads are inside the BeginScene wait loop, so cheaper reads do not raise FPS.
not_applied.4_gpu_lock_yield_inside_display_lists: Implemented and reverted: the yield never triggered (dl_yields=0), so the waits happen outside display lists (copies, texture creation, frame seal). Unproven synchronization changes were not kept.
not_applied.display_copy_bind_group_cache: Still reverted pending a stable baseline.

validation.unattended_100s_runs: two runs, 60.0 FPS in all 8 windows each (previously 57-59), 0 crashes
validation.remaining: host lock wait still 0.5-3 s per 10 s in the unattended scene; source outside display lists, not yet located
